entries.text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_01

entries.text: Oh, the positive energy is positively flowing!\nI’d just love to buy up all this Kitakami air![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_02

entries.text: That’s my dearest O’Nare! Even while out in the\nboonies, your ideas are still purely metropolitan![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_01

entries.text: I do appreciate your willingness to speak\nthe truth, Billy![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_03

entries.text: So, my dearest O’Nare! However shall we waste\nour time and our money today?[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_02

entries.text: How, indeed...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_04

entries.text: Billy, look—a commoner! They’re staring at us...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_05

entries.text: Eh? A commoner?[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_03

entries.text: Why yes, your eyes do not decieve you—that\nthere is almost certainly a commoner![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_04

entries.text: As I live and breathe—a commoner! A living,\nbreathing commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_06

entries.text: Wh-whatever do we do, Billy?! Is it bad manners\nto ask to shake their hand? Is it acceptable to\r\nask for an autograph?![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_07

entries.text: Collect yourself, my dear O’Nare! No need to\nrush. Look! This commoner isn’t going anywhere![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_05

entries.text: My apologies... It’s not every day that I come\nface-to-face with a commoner, you see.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_08

entries.text: Naturally—you’re the president of Paldea Realty,\nafter all![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_06

entries.text: Excuse me? Yes, you—commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_09

entries.text: Would you be so kind as to indulge me in a duel\nwith your Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_10

entries.text: If you can defeat me, I will grant you riches\nbeyond your wildest imagination![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_11

entries.text: Th-there it is! O’Nare’s favorite pastime—[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_07

entries.text: throwing the common folk a bone![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_11

entries.text: Ohoho... Please come see me once you’re ready,\ndear commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_12

entries.text: If you want the great fortune O’Nare offered,\nyou should go speak to her, dear commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_npc

entries.text: Will you duel me for riches beyond your wildest\nimagination?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_13

entries.text:
You know, I think I quite like it when a commoner
tells me no now and then...\c
But the time of a Glitterati is exceedingly
valuable! We will have this battle RIGHT NOW![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_14

entries.text: I, O’Nare—the president of Paldea Realty—will\ncrush you, commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_15

entries.text: Pfwee, pfwee! Go get ’em, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_08

entries.text: You’re really something! A commoner a cut\nabove the rest![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_16

entries.text: Pfwee, pfwee! Not even defeat can eclipse your\nbeauty, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_09

entries.text: Now listen to me, commoner: the most important\nthing about money is how you use it.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_17

entries.text: Spend that reward on something meaningful—an\ninvestment in yourself.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_18

entries.text: That way, you’ll continue to sparkle, even when\nyour money is gone![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_19

entries.text: Come now, dear Billy! I think I’d quite like to go\nsee [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]that waterfall[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_woman_20

entries.text: Pfwee! We’ve only just arrived in Kitakami, yet\nnow we’re returning home! You really are an\r\nexemplary Glitterati![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_003_man_10

entries.text: Oh, my dear Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare... Where\nin the world are you?
entries.label: s1_sub_003_secretary_01

entries.text: Lady O’Nare said something about a place with a\nview of the bountiful fields of the countryside...\r\nbut where is that?
entries.label: s1_sub_003_secretary_02
